title: Isolate owners and retain terminal records

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Isolate owners and retain terminal records
steps.payload: For project and test job adapters, run manager/router tests covering agent/project/port isolation for status/wait/cancel/list, same-key changed-argument conflicts, short observation waits, and terminal retention. Use the injected clock for expiry rather than waiting 30 minutes; create a new manager to model restart.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Foreign lookups refuse or omit records; terminal results/checkpoints remain identical.
Expiry and restart lose records and keys without replaying work.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
